posts.body: Predictions: 13 of 13 Pending | Tied for 1st with 55 others Hwang vs. PolizziIn Soo Hwang, TKO, R1Hwang used to be a awesome fighter but his last 3 fights have all been absolutely horrible decisions. He went from going out there and knocking people out to going full Adesanya vs Romero on these guys. I'm praying he has heard the criticism of his recent performances and goes for the kill hereBae vs. KimHan Seul Kim, DECBoth of these guys are coming out of retirement but Kim fought last year and Bae hasn't fought in over 6 years and is now 39 years old. I'll go with the younger guy that has actually been active recentlyKang vs. SungJi Won Kang, TKO, R1Kang has actually fought and knocked out people with a pulseChoi vs. QuinlanJun Seo Choi, DECQuinlan might show higher level experience here but I can't pick him to beat a physical guy like Choi when he's looked so bad recentlyJang vs. KimYoon Sung Jang, TKO, R1Jang is one of the best prospects out of South Korea right now, his fight against a bigger more experienced guy on RTU was a strong showing and I hope to see him back there. This is a layup to get him back in the win columnPark vs. SeoChan Soo Park, TKO, R1Some horrid matchmaking here. Park is one of the best guys in Korea right now and he's fighting a 2-2 guyNabiev vs. KyungNabi Nabiev, SUB, R1Nabiev some some typical Russian record padding wins but he actually seems pretty legit. Very explosive and jumps on finishes as soon as he sees themJoo vs. ChoiSeung Guk Choi, DECChoi has actually fought some fairly high level guys while Joo has a extremely padded record and got destroyed the moment he ran into another journeyman in his last fight
